title.fr: Les changements d'état physique d'un corps pur

formula: Q = m · L   (chaleur latente de changement d'état, plateau T constant)
sketch:
Observe: split view — left is a beaker with cartoon water molecules
and a Bunsen slider (heat input Q̇); right is a live T vs. Q plot.
Student turns the Bunsen up, watches T rise, then flat-line during
fusion (0 °C) and vaporisation (100 °C) as latent heat is absorbed.
Molecule animation transitions between states at each plateau.
Experiment: reproduce a target T(Q) curve by choosing initial mass +
heat rate. Evaluate: T(Q) curve is shown but state-labels stripped
from the molecule box; student names each plateau. Wrinkle: sublime a
corps that skips liquid (iode) — same UI, different plateau structure.
